entries.text: The bundled SQLGlot runtime moves from 30.24.0.10 to 30.24.0.11 (fork commit `dec472e77a7a`). At the runtime level, `decimal_zero_literals` keeps a `0.0` that shares its `CASE`/`IF` with a quotient already cast to `DOUBLE` or `FLOAT`, and `decimal_division_to_double` writes a `DOUBLE` zero beside such a quotient, so ClickHouse needs no Variant type. BenchBox calls `decimal_zero_literals` in `rewrite_query_for_clickhouse` but never `decimal_division_to_double`, and the changed guard only applies to a `0.0` beside a quotient whose dividend is already cast to `DOUBLE` or `FLOAT`: `rewrite_query_for_clickhouse` output for all 1,127 frozen shipped queries, the 23,667 translations across 21 target dialects, the 2,600 golden-corpus runtime outputs and `make sql-execution-gate` are unchanged from 30.24.0.10, so no published result changes.
